name: Rowanvale 1.1 — A shell that keeps working offline
releaseNotes: Rowanvale 1.1 keeps the installed app opening without a network after the shell stopped depending on the redirecting /index.html path, and finishes the artwork repairs so more cards carry real covers.
changes: Offline navigation survives a shell installed without a cached copy of the redirecting index.html
A cached redirect or error page can no longer lock a returning browser out of every navigation
Artwork lookup requests all page images, so non-free box art resolves again
Stale cover cache entries are dropped when the resolver schema changes
